summary: CloudIVR legal profile (individual/business + address) feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 22/22 pytest pass (GET/PUT /profile/legal + validation incl. no-postcode countries AE/HK/IE, /profile/legal/later, 428 profile_required gate on /numbers/buy, /numbers/checkout, /numbers/:phone/extra, /numbers/:phone/extra-checkout, /fax-numbers, Google address suggest/place proxy with real calls, 401 unauth, dry-run purchase -> numberResaleRecords {resold:true,endUser,note} + phoneNumbersOf number has resold:true + endUser, admin GET /admin/users/:chatId legalProfile + resale). Frontend: banner + dialog, Individual/Business cards, business fields, server validation error shown, Google suggestions (5) -> pick fills street/city/region/postal, list closes and stays closed (also in a fast type-then-pick race and with keyboard ArrowDown+Enter), manual toggle, 'Details saved' toast, banner disappears; Buy page gate replaces Checkout until saved then Checkout appears; Settings card pill Complete / Needed to buy numbers + prefilled editable form saves; new sign-up shows 'Who will use your numbers?' dialog, 'Do this later' closes it, not shown again on reload, banner shows instead; admin drawer 'Number holder details' with resale line. One UX issue: on new sign-up the onboarding modal (z-80) opens on top of the profile setup dialog (z-60), so two modals stack.

minor.issue: Not gated by legalProfile.gate and does not call recordResale; a newly acquired replacement number gets no numberResaleRecords entry (it only inherits the old number's endUser via spread, which can be missing for numbers bought before this feature).
No profile gate or resale record. This may be intended (other providers), but the request said every number is recorded as resold.
Calls createLegalProfile(db) on every purchase, which runs createIndex each time. Should reuse the shared instance.

ui_bugs.issue: Right after sign-up both modals mount together. The profile dialog shows for a moment, then the onboarding 'What will you use CloudIVR for?' modal (z-[80]) covers it. The profile dialog (Modal z-[60]) can only be used after onboarding is skipped or finished. Fix: show ProfileSetupDialog only after onboarding is done (or the other way round).

issues: The 'Details saved' toast (bottom-right) sits over the 'Pay' button for a few seconds.
For a Google result with a premise name (e.g. '221B Bakers, Bridge Street, Framlingham'), line2 gets the village name and the premise name is dropped. This is acceptable but worth checking.

action_items: Sequence the post-sign-up dialogs so the onboarding modal and 'Who will use your numbers?' do not stack (e.g. render ProfileSetupDialog only when onboarding data shows onboarded).
Decide whether /numbers/:phone/replace (and mobile/eSIM/texting numbers) need the profile gate and recordResale; at minimum record a resale for replacement numbers.
Reuse the shared legalProfile instance in fax.js instead of creating one per request.
critical_code_review_comments: legal-profile.js: the per-account rate limiter Map 'hits' never evicts entries (small memory growth).
AddressField: an in-flight suggest request is not cancelled when the user picks. No re-open was seen in tests, but an AbortController or a request id would make this safe.
PUT /profile/legal accepts an unknown countryCode such as 'ZZ' as long as it is 2 letters. Consider checking it against the country list.
